name: Nuclear plant safety
summary: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power for the 16th time in 2026 on 8 Nov; IAEA warns on Ukraine's winter grid
state: Zaporizhzhia lost its 330kV Ferrosplavna-1 line at 02:36 on 8 Nov, its 16th complete loss of off-site power in 2026 and 27th since the war began, relying on diesel generators until the line was restored (Interfax-Ukraine). On 18 Nov IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi told the Board he was deeply concerned about Ukraine's grid as winter sets in, and that the plant depends on a single line while a ceasefire for repairs to the 750kV line is discussed (ANS). Searches on 28 Nov found no damage to safety-critical systems, INES level 2 event or radiological release.
for_you: There is no radiological risk to the UK or Europe reported. In an emergency, follow official guidance from national authorities and the IAEA; FCDO travel advice covers Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Plant lost all off-site power on 8 Nov and IAEA reports a deteriorating grid situation: Watch
